_note: Found-vs-oracle DEPTH sweep: scale-free (Barabasi-Albert) networks, edgesPerNode=3 (mean degree ~6), UNLIMITED capacity, ideal conditions (no latency/drops/sleeping). Sweeps the depth bound D (= the protocol's maxDepth AND the oracle's depth; the sim runner probes both at the SAME depth) over entityCount N in {100, 1000}. Question: at matched depth, does the decentralised protocol find the routes the oracle sees? Post tallynet-discovery-depth-reach, reach = maxDepth = L (one round per level), so pFoundGivenExists should be ~1 with NO reach-cadence gap — the sweep confirms that and exposes depth as pure cost (messages/rounds grow). See ../README.md and packages/tallysim/docs/design.md.
